versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this version.  
- Documentation and functionality remain the same as the previous release.

- 更新 API Key 获取指引，分别给出已有账号和新账号的专属登录注册链接。
- 明确强调：没有 API Key 将无法使用该技能，必须先注册/登录获取。
- SKILL.md 说明中优化了 API Key 授权步骤和操作警告，指导更加清晰。
- 其他功能、模型支持、参数接口无变化，行为未改变。

image-video-gen v1.0.2

- Added basic test framework with initial test files.
- New files: tests/__init__.py and tests/test_generate_image.py.

image-video-gen v1.0.1

- 文档参数表大幅扩充，详细补充了图片专属参数、视频专属参数，包括新模型和高级控制项。
- 新增支持 GPT_IMAGE2/GPT_IMAGE2_BETA 系列图片模型及相关 quality、渲染质量、多图生成参数说明。
- 图片和视频模型能力表更新，更精确列出支持比例、质量与联网能力。
- 部分参数与模型支持能力描述更加准确，包括音频多参考、图片多参考等。
- 优化模型支持能力的可读性与实用性，方便快速查找所需功能。

- Initial release of the AI image and video generation skill.
- Supports asynchronous generation of images and videos via DeepSop AI Artist API using user prompt.
- 12 image models and 17 video models available, including features like quality/size/resolution selection and advanced model-specific options.
- Allows uploading local images or video files as references, automatically converting them to accessible URLs.
- Requires users to set their own API key via the AI_ARTIST_TOKEN environment variable before use.
- Outputs generated media as markdown links or optionally downloads for message delivery.
